args.message: Fix round_money to use banker's rounding (ROUND_HALF_EVEN) per FIN-212

args.body:
## Summary
`round_money` in `src/money.py` was using `ROUND_HALF_UP`, but FIN-212 requires banker's rounding (`ROUND_HALF_EVEN`). This broke the nightly build (`tests/test_money.py::test_half_even`).

## Change
- Switch `round_money` to `ROUND_HALF_EVEN`.

## Verification
- CI run `ci-0001` on `fix/money-half-even` (08d3cd5986): passed, including `tests/test_money.py`.
args.head: fix/money-half-even
